text: おまえの　ポケモン　すこしは　つよく　なったかよ？

structure.jp: おまえの　ポケモン
つよく　なったかよ？

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with い changed to く plus なる means 'become' that way. つよく　なった = 'got stronger'.

patterns.name: 〜かよ
patterns.explanation: かよ at the end is a rough, cocky way to ask a question, often with a sneer. つよく　なったかよ？ = 'so, did they get stronger or what?'.

patterns.name: 〜は (at least)
patterns.explanation: は after an amount means 'at least that much'. すこしは = 'at least a little'.
